limits: Local single-cohort samples, not statistical latency distributions or whole-repository recall.
Default and CTracer are separate trials; original failed adapter trial retained.
Unconfirmed memory mutation has no recall credit; later cycle rejection still preserves its observed contract.
Non-Python/source-read/subprocess and re-export boundary misses are this cohort's observations.
Residual setup/reset/reporting time is aggregate, not an isolated SQLite/map-maintenance benchmark.
No real game, full native app, package upgrade, xdist compatibility or full-repository instrumentation trial.
